message.content: {"status":"ADVISORY","observations":["USCo has an upcoming supplier invoice obligation (INV-SG-001) due 2026-09-25 for 250,000 USD to SUP-SG-001, which can be settled in USD or USDC.","USCo's USD bank operating account (ACC-US-OPER-01) has a current balance of 1,250,000 USD, and its USDC wallet (WAL-US-USDC-01) has 300,000 USDC (treated as 1:1 USD equivalent).","There is no liquidity gap or shortfall for USCo in either USD or USDC; both balances are sufficient to cover the obligation.","No transfer or liquidity action is required to meet this obligation at this time."]}
